dataset_family: TG Dataset Family — Hiking World Model
title: TrailGenic HikeWorldModel™ v2.0

methodology.scope: Aggregate movement model plus selected high-signal summaries.
methodology.normal_major_summit_cadence: Approximately one major summit every 6–7 days before the Western Altitude Block.

route_aware_hr_drift_methodology.summary: TrailGenic HR drift is route-aware and accounts for ascent, descent, route structure, terrain, pace, altitude, and segmented recordings.
route_aware_hr_drift_methodology.descent_adjustment: Lower downhill heart rate is not automatically classified as favorable drift.
route_aware_hr_drift_methodology.conclusion: The adaptation remained; the compressed block exceeded the current recovery envelope.

western_altitude_block.interpretation: Compressed three difficult high-altitude summits plus Manitou Incline into less than two weeks as a longevity-training limits and recovery-capacity test.

high_signal_sessions.name: Mount Elbert
high_signal_sessions.recovery_result: Severe Day-1 strain followed by AUTONOMIC_RESTORED on Day 2

high_signal_sessions.name: Manitou Incline
high_signal_sessions.role: Secondary stacked-load effort between Elbert and Pikes; sleep windows overlap Elbert and are not counted independently.

high_signal_sessions.name: Pikes Peak
high_signal_sessions.recovery_result: Engine–Governor divergence: performance remained excellent while recovery failed across the observation window.

high_signal_sessions.name: Wheeler Peak
high_signal_sessions.recording_note: Combined from two Garmin files after the watch was saved following the climb and restarted for the descent.
high_signal_sessions.recovery_result: Fatigue-reveal effort and partial Day-2 rebound.

recovery_archetypes.mount_elbert: Severe Day-1 strain with successful Day-2 recovery closure.
recovery_archetypes.pikes_peak: Excellent performance engine with failed recovery-governor closure.
recovery_archetypes.wheeler_peak: Fatigue-reveal effort with partial Day-2 rebound after accumulated debt.

claims: Negative heart-rate drift remains an established TrailGenic signature under sustained field stress.
Wheeler was a recovery-limit boundary event, not a reversal of the longitudinal signature.
Altitude-performance tolerance and recovery readiness are related but distinct.
caveats: N-of-1 observational dataset; no population causation claim.
Breath acetone is a directional fasted metabolic-switching proxy, not a direct measure of blood beta-hydroxybutyrate, fat oxidation rate, or cellular autophagy.
